mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, school_name AS schoolName, school_type AS schoolType, major, plan_content AS planContent, plan_time AS planTime, record_time AS recordTime, status, remark FROM study_up WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalCount, COUNT(IF(status = #{pending_plan}, 1, NULL)) AS waitPlanStudent, COUNT(IF(status = #{planned}, 1, NULL)) AS plannedStudent FROM study_up WHERE deleted =0
AND plan_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
